cause_quote: The new HTML-island parser ran `const children = unwrapUnclosed(node.children);` at every nesting level without a depth limit, and its `<details>` renderer also recursed through `const blocks = htmlNodesToBlocks(bodyNodes);`.
user_saw: Telegram users received a generic failure notice instead of the assistant's reply when it contained deeply nested details blocks.
summary: The fix caps Telegram rich nesting at 15 container levels, flattens deeper content while preserving text and media URLs, and makes depth measurement iterative.
reasoning: The preceding rich-block emitter sent gaps through paragraph rendering, and the HTML-island feature introduced typed details blocks with unbounded recursive parsing and rendering. I checked the later transport-limit and details-rendering changes, which addressed other behavior while leaving deeply nested details without a cutoff.
